verdict.rationale: Blink's own docs say Mosh lets sessions survive network changes ('jump from home, to the train, and then to the office') and that connections stay intact after device sleep, and they document the `mosh` command. Community users corroborate 'solid connectivity' and mosh support. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how sleep persistence works and its limits (e.g. SSH vs Mosh sessions), independent hands-on reports specifically confirming survival across sleep and network roaming.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can keep my terminal session alive across network changes and device sleep

citations.quote: You can flawlessly jump from home, to the train, and then to the office thanks to Mosh. Blink is rock-solid connected all the way.
don't be afraid to put your device to sleep, when you wake it up later, your connections will be intact.
